method: Full-year exhaustive 1m lower-envelope screen for an ideal continuously repriced fair-price peg. Current-minute index low is used only as a conservative offline proof of unavoidable dynamic price-through, never as a live decision input.
important_limitations: This is a sufficient-trigger screen, not exact fill timing or P&L.
It undercounts opportunities when index was above its minute low at the spot-low instant.
Exact Binance aggTrades + OKX L2 at the trigger instant are required for final execution and 100ms P&L.
Ideal dynamic repricing ignores cancel/replace latency; stale-anchor risk must be tested separately.
